theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (V : ℝ), IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V) → ∃ c : ℝ, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |u y - c| ≤ 2 ^ (m + 2) * Real.sqrt (m + 1) * V
